description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siyabalangamuwa, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420103
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and owner details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
